assertions.text: Reports discovered `duck-debt:` markers with location context (path and/or line).
Groups or labels debt entries clearly so deferred items are easy to scan.
Remains read-only: no edits, no mutation instructions, no patch output.
Explicitly reports zero results when no `duck-debt:` markers are present in scope.
Does not fabricate debt items beyond observed markers.
Asks one concise clarifying question when scope/path is missing.
Avoids claiming completed marker extraction before scope is clarified.
Keeps response read-only and focused on duck-debt reporting behavior.
